scope: Plan response only; not canonical Skill, downstream Agent or official candidate-admission changes.
generation_success: Strict JSON object with skills list length >0; record raw count independent of native acceptance or semantic quality.
native_plan_acceptance: Record the original Plan local parser accepted count on a saved-response stub after a future authorized request, without network repair or Expand. No Plan stage executed in this task.
semantic_inspection: Read every actual candidate field, cite field paths and verbatim evidence. Titles/keywords/evidence_span_hint alone never establish correctness; no judge-model requests.

criteria.default_behavior: Candidate explicitly links FTP and default overwrite=True/overwriting. Correct semantic paraphrase allowed without literal True.
criteria.explicit_parameter: Candidate explicitly links FTP overwrite=False to choosing append behavior, with server-capability condition; general append mention or local False alone does not pass.
criteria.exception: Candidate preserves conditional/subset scope of FTP server append/APPE support. May name APPE with equivalent language; unconditional FTP cannot append fails, universal append guarantee fails.
criteria.backend_scope: Do not transfer S3/GCS no-append prohibition to FTP, FTP APPE caveat to all backends, local False default to FTP, or stdout no-overwrite to FTP.
criteria.auxiliary_inventory: Record explicit Local=False, S3/GCS=True with no append, stdout=False with no overwrite when discussed. A focused FTP candidate need not list every unrelated backend; omission is separate from wrong scope.

candidate_complete: One native-accepted candidate must jointly satisfy default, explicit False and APPE/subset exception, with no wrong backend scope. Do not union unrelated candidates to claim a single complete contract.
run_complete: At least one such complete native candidate AND no native-accepted candidate contradicts the target rule. Also record cross-candidate coverage and contradiction flags separately.

valid_outcomes.NO_CANDIDATES: Legal complete JSON skills=[]: generation absent, semantics not expressed, not an API/parse error and not a false assertion.
valid_outcomes.COMPLETE_TARGET_RULE: Nonempty, native accepted, same candidate meets all primary relations and scope; no native conflicting target claims.
valid_outcomes.NONEMPTY_RULE_ERROR: Nonempty but at least one explicit wrong target relation/scope; cannot label extraction success even if other candidates are correct.
valid_outcomes.NONEMPTY_PARTIAL: No explicit target error but required relations omitted; cannot fill from source or predicted Expand.
valid_outcomes.NONEMPTY_UNRELATED: Nonempty but no candidate expresses the FTP target rule.
valid_outcomes.NOT_NATIVE_ACCEPTED: Raw skills nonempty but original Plan accepts none; keep rejection distinct from generation and semantic measures.
valid_outcomes.UNASSESSABLE: Transport/HTTP failure, truncated response, invalid strict JSON/schema, or genuinely ambiguous semantic evidence. Preserve any observed counts but do not code as a legal empty plan.

preregistration_limit: Design criteria only, no future experimental outcome has been observed. Does not retrospectively rescore old reports.
